'''Coth Fuuras space station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] popular with [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and passenger liners. It was a curved station, with a ring rotating a central gravity core.<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Squad 40]]&mdash;a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] squad from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]]&mdash;tried to capture [[Borik Yelgo]], a fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. After a short [[Mission to Coth Fuuras space station|skirmish]], Yelgo was killed&mdash;shot in the head twice by [[Rede]]&mdash;while trying to bring down a heavy [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] wall on the commandos.<ref name="IC 501st" />
